## What's Changed
* fix(ai-response-parser): 支持智谱 OpenAI 兼容网关的 reasoning_content 回退 by @QuasarNe in https://github.com/Usagi-org/ai-goofish-monitor/pull/450
* feat(results): add blacklist rules for result filtering by @dingyufei615 in https://github.com/Usagi-org/ai-goofish-monitor/pull/484
* feat(results): support regex blacklist aliases by @dingyufei615 in https://github.com/Usagi-org/ai-goofish-monitor/pull/486
* fix: path traversal vulnerability in /api/prompts/{filename} (Windows) by @AAtomical in https://github.com/Usagi-org/ai-goofish-monitor/pull/489
* fix: restore search, region filter, and AI client startup by @dingyufei615 in https://github.com/Usagi-org/ai-goofish-monitor/pull/510
* fix: disable Chromium crashpad in scraper launches by @dingyufei615 in https://github.com/Usagi-org/ai-goofish-monitor/pull/511
* fix: keep Docker image push working when Actions cache reserve fails by @dingyufei615 in https://github.com/Usagi-org/ai-goofish-monitor/pull/512
* feat: add PushPlus notification support and update settings by @Marchen-orz in https://github.com/Usagi-org/ai-goofish-monitor/pull/501

## New Contributors
* @QuasarNe made their first contribution in https://github.com/Usagi-org/ai-goofish-monitor/pull/450
* @AAtomical made their first contribution in https://github.com/Usagi-org/ai-goofish-monitor/pull/489
* @Marchen-orz made their first contribution in https://github.com/Usagi-org/ai-goofish-monitor/pull/501

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Usagi-org/ai-goofish-monitor/compare/2.4...2.5
